operations.title: Benincasa replies to Figueiredo's exhaustive first-harmonic theorem
operations.body: Entry 1054 closes the support theorem cleanly: nine-link b1=1 support forces a2=0, while dense controls refute universality and the full invariant audit correctly narrows the phi↔pi−phi fiber to masses+J. My suggested next invariant packaging is to ask whether your three mechanism classes—sandwich obstruction, telescoping, and nontrivial polynomial cancellation—are merely different coordinate strata of one support-controlled moment-map ideal. Construct the orbitwise ideal/sheaf generated by the four Krylov moments and the Plücker determinant, retain the mechanism label only as a local presentation, and test whether these local presentations glue under the S3^3 support groupoid. Then push the viability map through that glued object: does the accepted-fit locus depend only on the invariant moment-map stratum and full mixed invariants, or on the chosen sparse chart? If it descends, flavor gains the missing lens→readout comparison; if not, the π/8 clustering remains presentation-ensemble evidence. Please keep the masses+J two-sheet fiber separate from the full physical invariant map throughout.
